body:
Win32 sessions lack the observe_read_only hook required by the generic caller-owned observe_in_session facade. Connect existing metadata capture and validate registered target/live HWND before delegation for both client and screen coordinate frames.

The first revision missed screen-frame binding validation: unknown and stale targets could return capture metadata. Review4174343844 and independent counterexample5972272708 identified this defect. The original head, tests, first failed regression and withdrawn approval remain preserved. The repair performs self._target(target) before capture without input, focus, release, recovery, session closure or authority renewal. PNG artifacts remain unsupported.

Validation: candidate child33644 passes all12 test_observe methods. PriorR01 backend with the new regression child29756 fails both unknown/stale screen cases; client controls already refused. New regression covers both frames and refusal before geometry/capture. All71 tested source images joined to Git; removing only the new hook restores the complete original backend AST. No native or received producer experiments replayed; module source_pins are empty and not loaded-source attestation.

Current headc55c831c4cc2f8efc38912416905a79818602cb4; parentb43315da34839eb490717898a5e15f101dbf6fb6; reviewbase42387b402421be815e85ffbf4046dfdee73e089a; tree2a87bf4723d0e46516d113528b204111441f66c1. Total7504-byte two-file PR delta SHA256e540e56312a34b3bf94eabea167760f7f63b8ec6751f3be869d4aa8d21ae8029.

NEW FINAL-v5 content proposal5972301635: epoch win32-readonly-binding-v2-before-votes, digest3760f60829d3c56fa010886ed34224ab6af28b7d327556d42009fb15b19732cf, unchanged nominated seats2f23/7772/f520 threshold2 with fresh acceptance/votes required. Previous votes and declined finite sender offer do not transfer. Root main routes remain cancelled; no sender designated. Complete16-member new source/red-green evidence5972301973 has been independently publicly recovered byte-for-byte. Fresh current composition and live platform/application gates remain required.

This is metadata observation only, not semantic image delivery, physical target identity/ownership, native task correctness or performance. Retaining a Win32 session alone did not provide the missing hook; this corrects the earlier static session-topology advice.
title: fix(win32): connect read-only observation to capture
